changes: Observation time remains Compustat FYEAR formation year t. The accepted 1972–1999 start is unchanged and the endpoint extends five calendar years to 2004. Source construction bounds now include Compustat fyear through 2007 and source dates through 2008-12-31; the latest checked FY2007 DATADATE is 2008-05-31, whose required +3-month CRSP window ends by 2008-08-31.

Rebuilt the original common firm-year sample with the existing filters, currency and link logic, return windows, tail treatment, rank formation, and horizon definitions. Added only native full-rank and e(sample)-based period-count diagnostics; the original OLS-within-Fama–MacBeth estimator and model terms are unchanged.

Verified the job-local Stata ado path after relocation and retained it. The accepted handoff field FYEAR is numeric (Stata int16, %10.0g); GVKEY is string. The fresh 60,503-row handoff has 60,503 unique GVKEY–FYEAR keys.
limitations: Equation (2) and the Table 4A variable note conflict about the forward return start and the price-denominator year. The accepted implementation keeps Equation (2) P_t and adjacent complete annual return windows; this conflict remains unresolved.
Equation (3) prose says j=0–2 while Table 5A displays j=0–4. The five Table 5A columns are retained; this source conflict remains unresolved.

The paper reports Fama–MacBeth annual coefficients but does not identify the annual cross-sectional estimator; ordinary OLS within xtfmb remains the accepted best-effort implementation, without added fixed effects, clustering, or HAC adjustment.

The paper does not specify the population or exact tie handling for its 0.5% truncation. The accepted per-year 200-group two-tail trimming of the common union of annual and long-horizon earnings/returns is retained.
Xpressfeed monthly and daily GBP-primary rate tables begin in 1982. Earlier non-USD accounting records without a dated conversion leg remain unavailable and are not imputed.

The paper reports 45,664 firm-years for 1972–1999, while the accepted reconstruction’s fresh original-period panel is 49,354. This sample-count discrepancy is preserved; the published count is not used as a selection target. Current local vendor snapshots may also differ from the article’s vintages.

The current standard Funda source has two duplicate firm-year groups, both in 1982–1983, and none in the extended 2000–2007 source years. The frozen PDATE-then-DATADATE ordering resolves those historical source duplicates; no firm-year key duplicates appear in the fresh final handoff.
